coverage.message: The public federated catalog returned an empty features list for the selected Lyman bounding box.
Five anonymous photo searches with 2000 m radius around central, northern, southern, eastern, and western Lyman each returned API code 601 (empty response).

Mapillary announced disabled viewing and downloading of Ukraine imagery in March 2022 for civilian safety. Its official forum still reported the restriction in August/September 2026. No restricted imagery was accessed.

15 historical civilian reference photographs with individual CC licenses are stored locally. Five have unverified source reference geotags; ten have unknown positions. These are individual photographs, not navigable street-view coverage.
The existing Lyman sample contains 285 buildings: 163 have mapped level counts; none have roof shape, colour or material tags in the audited source. Missing roof values remain unknown.

At the Lyman centre only, Esri metadata reports WorldView-2/Vantor imagery captured 2023-09-29: 0.5 m source pixels, 0.6 m sampled pixels. Automated extraction terms require noncommercial use within ArcGIS; this app does not extract its roof pixels.
Open Sentinel-2 RGB pixels are 10 m across: useful for broad landscape context, too coarse for reliable small-building roof colours or shapes.
Overture documents optional roof attributes. Actual Lyman roof values have not been verified or imported; schema support does not establish local coverage.

visualReview.summary: Close-up of passenger station entrance with pale green plaster, broad white arched mouldings, triangular pediment/cornice, red and blue raised sign letters and white window framing. It is a facade detail, not an overall station view or roof survey.

observations.description: White rendered vertical piers frame pink-beige rectangular cladding panels. Tall windows repeat in bays; the stepped parapet hides the roof, so its shape is unknown.

attributes.windowStyle: Tall rectangular glazed bays with smaller upper panes
attributes.roofNote: Roof hidden behind stepped parapet; do not infer flat roof from this view.

observations.description: Three timber-coloured double-door entrances share a shallow corrugated canopy above broad steps. The ramp visible at the right is a local detail, not a measured accessible route.

attributes.style: Broad entrance steps; shallow metal canopy; timber-coloured doors

observations.description: Large square grey paving slabs form a grid in the forecourt, with dark weathered joints and some grass at edges.

attributes.paving: Large square concrete-like slabs with weathered joints

observations.description: Tall dark conifers frame the facade on both sides. Their exact species, heights and positions cannot be measured from this photo.

attributes.vegetation: Tall evergreen conifers beside the front forecourt

observations.description: Four rows of windows are visible in a pale exposed-brick facade, with green frames, a dark masonry base and a stepped parapet. Four visible storeys are an observation, not a measured building height.

attributes.windowStyle: Green rectangular window frames in regular bays
attributes.roofNote: Roof surface not visible; shape unknown.

observations.description: The entrance projects forward with reddish steps and doors, a shallow light canopy, a clock and a painted decorative panel. These need custom geometry or a prefab to reproduce faithfully.

attributes.style: Projecting entrance with red-brown steps and doors, shallow canopy and decorative wall panel

observations.description: Large rectangular grey paving slabs form the courtyard; pale painted curbs border narrow planted strips.

attributes.paving: Grey concrete-like slab grid; white-painted low curbs

observations.description: Deciduous trees stand in narrow planted strips beside the courtyard. Lower trunks are painted white; foliage is sparse in this historical view.

attributes.vegetation: Deciduous trees, white-painted lower trunks, grass strips

observations.description: Tan exposed brick, dark arched openings, a blue segmented dome and gold onion-shaped caps are visible. This special roof requires a custom model; the standard flat/gabled/hipped generator cannot reproduce it.

attributes.roofNote: Blue main dome and gold onion-shaped caps; custom roof model required.

observations.description: A dark metal fence with narrow vertical bars and curved tops runs across the foreground. The line, height and gates need separate mapping; this is a style reference only.

attributes.style: Thin vertical bars and curved top ornaments

observations.description: Deciduous trees partly obscure the facade, with a tall conifer to the right. Do not interpret the reference geotag as any tree position.

attributes.vegetation: Mixed deciduous trees and conifers close to facade

observations.description: Dense pale reeds border the near left and right banks; the centre of the near bank is more open.

attributes.vegetation: Bands of tall dry reeds along pond margins

attributes.vegetation: Mixed waterside trees with some weeping crowns

observations.description: A large masonry city-entry marker has a white sloping base and raised red lettering. A custom landmark prefab would capture the appearance; the geotag is not a surveyed sign position.

attributes.style: White concrete-like plinth, vertical slab, raised red letters

observations.description: A weathered asphalt road and broad paved junction meet grassy and dirt verges. No continuous lane markings are clearly visible in this view.

attributes.paving: Weathered grey asphalt with unpaved shoulder

observations.description: Dense tall conifers line both sides of the approach road and stand behind the city marker.

attributes.windowStyle: White rectangular frames between vertical piers

observations.description: Grey precast-looking concrete fence panels repeat a decorative relief pattern along the perimeter.

observations.description: Mesh fence panels and slender posts enclose parts of the sports ground.

observations.description: Tall floodlight posts stand around the sports ground. Height, number of lamps and exact locations are not measured from this reference.

attributes.style: Tall sports-ground floodlight pole; use an appropriate floodlight prefab

attributes.windowStyle: White frames within broad arched facade mouldings
attributes.roofNote: Facade close-up only; overall roof is outside the view.

observations.description: A triangular pediment and white cornice frame raised red and blue sign lettering above the entrance.

attributes.style: White triangular pediment and cornice with raised red-blue lettering

notes: Fifteen individual historical photographs are available locally. They do not provide continuous street coverage or current city conditions.
Visual attributes are reviewed from these images; colour values are approximate under the photographed lighting.
Unlinked observations are style references. No building or prop has been automatically matched to a photo geotag.
Ten added references have no returned geotag; their camera and object coordinates remain unknown.
Source-reported capture dates are attributed in dateMetadata, while capturedAt remains null.
Four new photographs support approximate roof-section colours and component notes; they do not establish simple building-wide roof types.
